buildCommand: for f in ./vercel-build.sh ./agent/vercel-build.sh ../agent/vercel-build.sh; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "running $f"; bash "$f"; break; fi; done; if [ ! -f public/index.html ]; then for p in ../public ./agent/../public; do if [ -f "$p/index.html" ]; then rm -rf public; cp -R "$p" ./public; break; fi; done; fi; echo "publishing $(pwd)/public"; ls public
